input: hi how much for a cleaner for a 2 bed flat? just a normal clean
expected: Hi! A standard clean is $35 an hour with a 3-hour minimum, so $105 or more. Most 2-bedroom flats take 3–4 hours. Our cleaners bring all the products, and eco products are available on request. Book at tidyhome.example/book or in the app.

input: can I move my cleaning from tomorrow to friday?
expected: Yes. Open the app (or tidyhome.example/book), go to My bookings, select tomorrow's clean and tap Reschedule. Because it's less than 24 hours away, a $30 change fee applies. If something urgent came up, mention it when you reschedule and our team will take it into account.

input: The handyman cracked my bathroom tile while fixing the towel rail. Not happy.
expected: I'm sorry, that's not the result you should get. Please reply with a photo of the cracked tile and the date of the visit. I've passed this to our team as a damage report, and they'll get back to you within 1 business day to arrange a repair or cover the cost.

input: do you guys do electrical? need a new light fitting wired in
expected: Our handymen don't do electrical wiring, so for a new light fitting you'll need a qualified electrician. We can still help with things like hanging mirrors and shelves, furniture assembly or other small repairs.

input: we have mice in the kitchen. how fast can someone come and what does it cost
expected: Sorry, mice are no fun. An inspection costs $80, and that's deducted if you go ahead with treatment. Mouse treatments usually cost $150–$320, depending on how big your home is and how many mice there are. The earliest available slots are shown when you book pest control in the app or at tidyhome.example/book. Store food in sealed containers until the visit.

input: Cleaner never showed up today and nobody told me. I waited 3 hours.
expected: I'm really sorry. Waiting 3 hours with no word isn't acceptable. I've passed this to our team so they can find out what happened, rebook you at a time that suits you and look at making it right, and they'll get back to you within 1 business day. If you'd like the first available slot, you can also rebook in the app right away.

input: what do I need to do before the deep clean
expected:
To help the deep clean go smoothly:
1. Clear clutter from surfaces and floors so the cleaners can reach everything.
2. Put away valuables and anything fragile.
3. Let us know about pets or parking in the booking notes.
You don't need to provide any products. The cleaners bring everything.

input: i smell gas in the kitchen, can your handyman check the cooker
expected: Please don't wait for a handyman. Leave the property now, don't use switches or flames, and call the gas emergency line straight away. Turn off the gas at the meter on your way out if it's safe. Our team can't work on gas appliances, so once the emergency service has made it safe, contact a registered gas engineer.

input: Can I get a quote to assemble 6 flat-pack wardrobes and some shelves
expected: Sure! Larger jobs get a custom quote. Please reply with the product names or photos of the boxes and the shelves, plus your postcode, and our team will send you a quote within 1 business day. As a guide, the rate is $60 for the first hour and $45 per extra half hour.

input: I want a refund, the clean was terrible. dust everywhere, bathroom not touched
expected: Sorry, that's not up to our standard. Under our satisfaction guarantee, we can send someone back within 48 hours to redo it for free. If you'd rather have a refund, I've passed your request to our team with your feedback, and they'll get back to you within 1 business day. Photos would help them.

input: how do I get a receipt for my last booking
expected: Receipts are emailed automatically after each visit, so check the email address on your account, including spam. You can also download them in the app under My bookings > Past > Receipt.

input: Do you do offices? We need a weekly clean for a 10 person office
expected: Yes, we clean small offices too. Recurring office contracts are set up by our team, so I've passed your request to them, and they'll get back to you within 1 business day with a quote. To help, reply with the office size, the day and time you prefer, and any special requirements.

input: is there a charge if I cancel?
expected: Cancelling is free up to 24 hours before your visit. Within 24 hours, there's a $30 fee. If the team arrives and can't get in, the first hour is charged. Cancel in the app under My bookings.

input: my laptop was on the desk before the cleaner came and now I can't find it
expected: I'm sorry, that's worrying. I've passed this to our team as urgent, and they'll contact the cleaner and get back to you within 1 business day. Please reply with the visit date and a description of the laptop. If you believe it was stolen, you may also want to report it to the police.

input: whats the arrival window? I have to leave by 2
expected: Our arrival window is 2 hours, and on the day the app shows the live ETA. If you have to leave by 2, choose a morning slot and add a note to your booking. If you can, you could leave a key or access instructions in the booking notes.

input: do your cleaners bring their own stuff or do I need to buy products
expected: Our cleaners bring all the products and equipment. If you'd like eco-friendly products, or have allergies, just add a note to your booking. If you have special surfaces, like natural stone or wooden floors, tell us, and we'll bring the right products.

input: hi! booked a handyman for shelves tmrw. also can he hang a tv on the wall? and do I need to buy the brackets?
expected: Yes, he can hang a TV as well. Please buy a wall bracket that matches your TV's size and weight, as the handyman doesn't carry brackets. Add the TV to your booking notes so he can plan his time. The TV and shelves together may run past the first hour, and each extra half hour is $45.

input: ur cleaner was rude to my mum. unacceptable
expected: I'm sorry, everyone should be treated with respect in their own home. I've passed your complaint to our team, and they'll look into it and get back to you within 1 business day. If you can, reply with the visit date and what happened. It'll be handled confidentially.

input: can you come every 2 weeks on tuesdays?
expected: Yes. When you book a clean in the app or at tidyhome.example/book, choose "Repeat every 2 weeks" and pick Tuesday. Where possible, we'll keep the same cleaner for every visit. You can pause or change the schedule any time in My bookings.

input: how do I pay? can I pay cash
expected: Payment is by card in the app after the visit, and your receipt is emailed automatically. We don't take cash at the moment. This keeps payments safe for both you and our staff.

input: the pest guy came last week and I still see cockroaches
expected: Sorry, that's frustrating. Seeing some cockroaches for a week or two after a treatment can be normal while it takes effect, but you shouldn't have to put up with it. Please book a follow-up in the app under My bookings > Past > Request follow-up, and our team will check whether a second treatment is needed.

input: Can I ask for the same cleaner as last time? She was great
expected: So glad you liked her! Add her name in the booking notes, or choose "Same cleaner as last time" in the app, and we'll book her whenever she's available. If she isn't free on that day, the app will suggest other times.

input: is it safe for my cat during the pest treatment?
expected: Our technicians will tell you exactly how to prepare, and it depends on which treatment is used. Usually pets need to stay out of the treated area for a few hours. Mention your cat when you book, and the technician will confirm before starting. If you have specific health concerns about your cat, ask your vet.

input: I want to talk to a manager
expected: Of course. I've passed your request to our team, and a manager will get back to you within 1 business day. If you tell me briefly what it's about, I'll add it to the note so you don't have to repeat yourself.

input: do you clean ovens?
expected: Yes. Oven cleaning is an add-on to any standard or deep clean, and it adds about an hour. Select "Oven" under add-ons when you book, or add it to an existing booking in My bookings.
